name: Watch manufacturers
note: Full category from the discovery query, minus exclusions below (not watch companies, or not companies), minus dissolved companies (Wikidata P576). discovery_sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?sitelinks WHERE { { ?item wdt:P452 wd:Q41767 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P452 wd:Q63346664 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P1056 wd:Q178794 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q136094627 . } ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks .
